ideas.title: Nuxt Ignores a Client-Only Widget During Static Generation Because the Page Was Rendered at Build Time
ideas.description: A widget that depends on browser APIs disappears or fails when Nuxt prerenders the page as static HTML.
ideas.angle: Open with the static-generation symptom and the page or component that fails to render as expected. Explain how Nuxt prerendering runs without a browser, why client-only code is stripped or deferred, and how that affects hydration and HTML output. Show when to use `<ClientOnly>`, page-level prerender settings, or route rules so the widget survives deployment.

ideas.title: Docker Cannot Reach Postgres on localhost Because the App Container Resolves Its Own Loopback Interface
ideas.description: A containerized app fails to connect to `localhost` because `127.0.0.1` points at the container, not the database host.
ideas.angle: Open with the exact connection error and the host string in the config. Explain container network namespaces, why `localhost` inside a container never means the host machine or another service, and how Compose service DNS changes the address you must use. Show how to point the app at the Postgres service name, expose ports only when needed, and confirm readiness separately from reachability.

ideas.title: Vite Refuses a CSS Import from `node_modules` with "does not exist under root" During Build
ideas.description: A production build can fail when a stylesheet import points outside Vite’s project root or references an unsupported path.
ideas.angle: Open with the exact Vite build error and the import path that triggers it. Explain how Vite’s root-based file serving and dependency scanning limit which files can be imported directly, and why some package asset paths work in dev but fail in build. Show how to import CSS through the package entry point, adjust `server.fs.allow` only when appropriate, or copy the asset into the app’s source tree.

drafted.title: Hono Loses Session Cookies on Cross-Origin Requests Because `fetch` Never Sends Credentials
drafted.description: Cookie-based auth fails when browser requests omit credentials or the response omits the correct CORS cookie headers.
drafted.angle: Open with the symptom the browser shows: the API responds, but the session cookie never persists or is never sent back. Explain the browser rules behind credentialed requests, `SameSite`, `Secure`, and the required `Access-Control-Allow-Credentials` plus exact origin header. Show how to configure Hono CORS, set cookies correctly, and verify the request includes `credentials: 'include'`.
